status.summary: Active but unbooked, and he has not fought since March. His unbeaten run ended with a majority-decision loss to Movsar Evloev (46-48, 46-48, 47-47) in a five-round main event in London (Mar 21, 2026), even though Evloev lost a point in round 4 for repeated groin strikes. He out-landed Evloev 89-86 in significant strikes but gave up 9 takedowns on 10 attempts, 8 of them in rounds 4-5. Two days later he said on Instagram that he tore a hip flexor in round 4 (MMA Fighting, Sportsnet). No recovery timeline was given and no later update was found. Before that he knocked out Aaron Pico with a spinning back elbow (R1 3:21, UFC 319, Chicago, Aug 16, 2025) and won five-round decisions over Josh Emmett (Apr 5, 2025) and Edson Barboza (May 18, 2024). Pro record 17-1-1 (ESPN, UFCalendar, ufcrankings.org); UFC 9-1-1. On Oct 26, 2026 he posted that every featherweight contender should need one more fight and that he had been told to beat a top-five opponent first (MiddleEasy). Aaron Pico (Oct 24-Nov 4) and Patricio Pitbull (Oct 26) have called him out, but ESPN and UFCalendar list no booking on Nov 6. Age 35.
status.ranking: #3 featherweight in both the UFC media-panel rankings (Nov 3, 2026, per ufcalendar.com; ufcrankings.org, updated Nov 5, agrees) and the UFC/Meta algorithmic rankings (Oct 31, 2026 board; ufcalendar.com, MMA Mania). ufc.com/rankings returned 403 to scripts.

style.summary: A long, patient striker who uses his 73-inch reach to keep fights at range: opponents throw 6.7 significant strikes per minute at him (league 8.7) and land 30% of head strikes (league 39%). He mixes punches with leg and body strikes and has finished fights with a clinch knee and a spinning back elbow. His problem is wrestling: he rarely shoots, and Evloev beat him by taking him down late.

moves.notes: Target split from fighters.json: decayed significant attempts are 74% head, 16% body, 10% legs (landed 62/21/17), close to the featherweight league (76/14/9.5) but with more of his landed strikes going low. Leg weights follow the leg-strike counts against Emmett (30) and Barboza (21 of 22). Body kicks are weighted above body punches as a judgment for a long-range kickboxer (87% of decayed landed strikes come at distance; ufcstats does not split punches from kicks). Spinning (0.12), knee (0.12) and elbow (0.08) are higher than for most featherweights because two of his three UFC KOs were a spinning back elbow (Pico) and a clinch knee (Amirkhani). The jab leads as a judgment for a long-reach range fighter; ufcstats does not record technique and no scouting breakdown could be opened this pass.

engine_notes.note: Five-round pace over three bouts (all went the distance): 1.00, 1.34, 1.59, 1.67, 1.17 of R1, against a featherweight league curve of 1.00, 1.31, 1.34, 1.55, 1.32. That is slightly above the league in R3-R4 and below it in R5.
Chin: 2 knockdowns absorbed in 11 UFC fights and no stoppage losses; decayed chin rate 0.52 per 100 head strikes absorbed (league 0.94).
Striking edge: +2.01 significant strikes per minute over the last 3 years; opponent-adjusted, he lands 1.17x what opponents usually absorb and absorbs 0.70x what they usually land.
Against Evloev he won the striking in R1-R2 (38-28) and lost the fight to late takedowns: Evloev went 8 of 9 in R4-R5 with 3:31 of control. Murphy attempted no takedowns.
